hunks.baseline: It was a method of regulating one’s energy by evening one’s breathing: drawing qi from outside the body, circulating it within, and accumulating it.
hunks.sol: It was a method of regulating one’s energy by steadying one’s breathing: drawing qi from outside the body, circulating it within, and accumulating it.

hunks.baseline: I had once heard that the human body contained more than three hundred and sixty acupoints, but based on what I could feel while circulating qi through the cultivation technique, there were even more than that.
hunks.sol: I had once heard that the human body contained more than three hundred and sixty acupoints, but based on what I could feel while using the cultivation technique, there seemed to be even more than that.

hunks.baseline: The ten years of internal energy I drew up from my dantian circulated through my body. If internal energy was a car, then the meridians were a highway. All I had to do was sit behind the wheel and press the accelerator.
hunks.sol: The ten years of internal energy I drew up from my dantian circulated through my body. If internal energy was a car, then my acupoints were the highway. All I had to do was sit behind the wheel and press the accelerator.

hunks.baseline: The internal energy raced along the straight and curving meridians throughout my body before returning to my dantian.
hunks.sol: The internal energy raced through the straight and curving pathways connecting the acupoints throughout my body before returning to my dantian.

hunks.baseline: A second internal energy occupied my dantian like an enormous boulder that would not budge, no matter how hard I willed it to.
hunks.sol: Another mass of internal energy occupied my dantian like an enormous boulder, refusing to budge no matter how hard I willed it to.

hunks.baseline: It had been a mystery ever since I first circulated qi. An unidentified energy that had taken root like it owned the place.
hunks.sol: It had been a mystery ever since I first circulated my qi—an unidentified energy that had settled in like it owned the place.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know where it had come from, how it had been formed, or why I couldn’t use it, but one thing was certain. This unidentified energy contained more power than the ten years of internal energy I possessed.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know where it had come from, how it had formed, or why I couldn’t use it, but one thing was certain. This unidentified energy contained even more power than the ten years of internal energy I possessed.

hunks.baseline: I also knew that I needed internal energy on the level of Lee Seogeun’s to become First Rate.
hunks.sol: I also knew that I needed about as much internal energy as Lee Seogeun had to become First Rate.

hunks.baseline: Internal energy was, strictly speaking, qi itself—something without a physical form. And yet the instant the two energies touched, I felt powerful rejection and resistance.
hunks.sol: Internal energy was, strictly speaking, qi itself—something without a physical form. And yet the instant the two energies touched, I felt a powerful rejection and repulsion.

hunks.baseline: No. It was even pulling me in. At this rate, it was going to eat me alive.
hunks.sol: No. It was even pulling my energy in. At this rate, it was going to swallow mine instead.

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly withdrew my internal energy and shook off the unidentified energy, which clung to me until the very end. At the same time, a System notification rang out.
hunks.sol: I hurriedly withdrew my internal energy and shook off the unidentified energy, which clung to it until the very end. At the same time, a System notification rang out.

hunks.baseline: I calmed my pounding heart and opened my Status Window.
hunks.sol: I calmed myself after the scare and opened my Status Window.

hunks.baseline: *Do I need to take a spirit pill, an elixir, something like that?*
hunks.sol: *Do I need to take a spirit pill, an elixir, or something?*

hunks.baseline: I thought of Jin Wikyung. If I screwed up my courage and said, *Big brother, just give me one spirit pill,* I didn’t think he would refuse me outright.
hunks.sol: I thought of Jin Wikyung. If I screwed up my courage and said, *Hyung, give me one spirit pill,* I didn’t think he would refuse me outright.

hunks.baseline: “It is beyond doubt. A few bones were broken, and there was some minor internal damage, but that level of injury could never—”
hunks.sol: “There’s no doubt about it. A few bones were broken, and there were some minor internal injuries, but that alone could never…”

hunks.baseline: “Are you sure? You swear that on the name of the Medicine King Hall Master?”
hunks.sol: “Are you sure? Will you stake your name as the Medicine King Hall Master on it?”

hunks.baseline: “Then why are you talking down to me? I treated you with respect because you’re another Hall Leader, and now you think I’m a joke!”
hunks.sol: “Then that settles it. Why are you talking down to me? I treat you with respect because you’re a fellow Hall Master, and now you think I’m a joke!”

hunks.baseline: “You were the one who started talking down to me, White Tiger Hall Leader!”
hunks.sol: “You were the one who started talking down to me, White Tiger Hall Master!”

hunks.baseline: “You think every Hall Leader is your equal? You’re nothing but some quack doctor!”
hunks.sol: “You think all Hall Masters are equal? You’re nothing but a mere physician!”

hunks.baseline: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to shove a large needle straight into his Huiyin Acupoint!”
hunks.sol: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to shove a large needle straight into your Huiyin Acupoint!”

hunks.baseline: —You came?
hunks.sol: —You’re here?

hunks.baseline: The voice sounded as if it had entered through my head rather than my ears. It was Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: The voice seemed to enter through my head rather than my ears. It was Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: I turned my head and met Jin Wikyung’s gaze from the seat of honor. He gave me a tired smile.
hunks.sol: I turned and met Jin Wikyung’s gaze from the seat of honor. He gave me a tired smile.

hunks.baseline: *You said it. Why did you call me to this madhouse, you old man?*
hunks.sol: *No kidding. Why did you call me into this madhouse, man?*

hunks.baseline: *The Elder Council? I’m involved in this matter?*
hunks.sol: *The Council of Elders? I’m involved in this matter?*

hunks.baseline: If there was one recent incident connected to me, it was the Mount Heng Sword Sect. And because of that incident, this thing called the Elder Council had summoned me.
hunks.sol: If there was one recent incident connected to me, it was the Mount Heng Sword Sect. And because of that incident, this Council of Elders or whatever it was had summoned me.

hunks.baseline: They watched the men with the M-shaped hairlines grab each other by the collars with cold eyes. Anyone could see it was a nursing home—or rather, the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: They watched the men with the M-shaped hairlines grab each other by the collars with cold eyes. Anyone could see it was a nursing home—or rather, the Council of Elders.

hunks.baseline: I had only just noticed that there were two seats of honor today. An old man was sitting to Jin Wikyung’s right, staring at me. His gaze made my face prickle.
hunks.sol: When had he gotten there? I had only just noticed that there were two seats of honor today. An old man was sitting to Jin Wikyung’s right, staring at me. His gaze made my face prickle.

hunks.baseline: White hair, a white beard, and white eyebrows. He looked like an immortal who had stepped out of an old painting. His back was straight, his shoulders broad, and his skin taut enough to make his age seem meaningless.
hunks.sol: White hair, a white beard, and white eyebrows. He looked like an immortal who had stepped out of an old painting. His back was straight, his shoulders broad, and his skin so taut that he hardly seemed old at all.

hunks.baseline: I gathered strength in my eyes and tried to glare back at the Head Elder…
hunks.sol: I narrowed my eyes and started to glare back at the Head Elder…

hunks.baseline: Not because I thought I would lose if we locked eyes. It was respect for my elders. Respect for my elders. Really.
hunks.sol: Not because I thought I would lose if we fought. It was respect for my elders. Respect for my elders. Really.

hunks.baseline: —You may not know this because you lost your memory, but the Head Elder is your great-uncle and the most senior elder in the family. Be especially careful with your words and actions.
hunks.sol: —You may not know this because you lost your memory, but the Head Elder is your great-uncle and the highest-ranking elder in the family. Be especially careful with your words and actions.

hunks.baseline: *Maybe this place has relatives by marriage, distant cousins, and every kind of obscure uncle, too.*
hunks.sol: *For all I knew, this place was full of in-laws eight times removed, distant cousins, and every kind of obscure uncle.*

hunks.baseline: —And… you must not be flustered by what happens from this point onward. Calmly tell them only the truth. Do you understand?
hunks.sol: —And… you must not be flustered by anything that happens from this point onward. Calmly tell them only the truth. Do you understand?

hunks.baseline: “I ask you this. Did you poison Lee Seogeun of the Mount Heng Sword Sect?”
hunks.sol: “I ask you this. Were you the one who poisoned Lee Seogeun of the Mount Heng Sword Sect to death?”

hunks.baseline: I barely managed to force the word out. My thoughts were a mess from the sudden question.
hunks.sol: I barely managed to force the word out. My thoughts were a mess after the sudden question.

hunks.baseline: “I have nothing to do with Lee Seogeun’s poisoning.”
hunks.sol: “I had nothing to do with Lee Seogeun’s poisoning.”

hunks.baseline: The problem was that, at some point, the atmosphere in the meeting hall began to grow strange.
hunks.sol: The problem was that, at some point, the atmosphere in the meeting hall began to take a strange turn.

hunks.baseline: White Tiger Hall Leader, was it? The man whose name I didn’t even know stared at me with obvious displeasure.
hunks.sol: White Tiger Hall Master, was it? The man whose name I didn’t even know stared at me with obvious displeasure.

hunks.baseline: I’d been letting it slide, and these bastards thought they could wrap me up like a cloth?[^1]
hunks.sol: I’d been letting it slide, and now these bastards thought I was some kind of wrapping cloth?[^1]

hunks.baseline: Fuming, I glared at the White Tiger Hall Leader as he sat down, then noticed something strange.
hunks.sol: Fuming, I glared at the White Tiger Hall Master as he sat down, then noticed something strange.

hunks.baseline: The White Tiger Hall Leader kept stealing glances at the old men of the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: The White Tiger Hall Master kept stealing glances at the old men of the Council of Elders.

hunks.baseline: The strange thing was that everyone who had been pressing and interrogating me was doing something similar.
hunks.sol: Curiously, everyone who had been pressing and interrogating me was doing something similar.

hunks.baseline: The Elder Council and Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: The Council of Elders and Jin Wikyung.

hunks.baseline: Even now, a power struggle was taking place between the senior members of the family and the Lesser Family Head who was young enough to be their grandson.
hunks.sol: Even now, a power struggle was taking place between the elders of the family and a Lesser Family Head young enough to be their grandson.

hunks.baseline: The old men of the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: The old men of the Council of Elders.

hunks.baseline: “Enough of this empty questioning. There is only one thing this old man wishes to ask. Where did this matter begin?”
hunks.sol: “Enough of these pointless questions and answers. There is only one thing this old man wishes to ask. Where did this matter begin?”

hunks.baseline: The senior members allied with the Elder Council answered as if they had been waiting for the question.
hunks.sol: The senior members allied with the Council of Elders answered as if they had been waiting for the question.

hunks.baseline: “Who was it that dragged our family’s reputation through the mud with disorderly words and conduct?”
hunks.sol: “Who was it that dragged our family’s reputation through the mud with his dissolute words and conduct?”

hunks.baseline: “Then who was it that provoked the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s prized treasure and brought us to this crisis?”
hunks.sol: “Then who was it that laid a hand on the treasured jewel the Mount Heng Sword Sect held in its palm and brought us to this crisis?”

hunks.baseline: [^1]: In Korean, the line puns on *boja* (“let’s see / wait and see”) and *bojagi*, a wrapping cloth.
hunks.sol: [^1]: The Korean line plays on *boja* (“let’s see”) and *bojagi*, a traditional wrapping cloth.
